title: Muscle fatigue is when a muscle can no longer contract, and many factors contribute
summary: OpenStax says muscle fatigue, with many contributing factors, is the point at which a muscle can no longer contract.
body: OpenStax says muscle fatigue occurs when a muscle can no longer contract, and that many factors contribute. It also says muscle use creates an oxygen debt. The chapter does not pick one cause and call it the whole story. This card is that definition of muscle fatigue. It does not explain sleepiness, illness, or a full day of feeling tired, and it is not advice to rest a particular person.

sources.title: 10.5 Types of Muscle Fibers, chapter review
sources.author: OpenStax
sources.note: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology, first edition, web view, CC BY 4.0. Paraphrase: muscle fatigue has many contributing factors and occurs when the muscle can no longer contract. Oxygen debt is mentioned as a result of muscle use.
